{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Congress can grant the Israeli administration a blank check.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"No mainstream politicians have the courage or foresight to call for the end of U.S. military aid to Israel.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. military aid to Israel should end until Israel ends all illegal settlement activity and demonstrates a renewed willingness to trade land for peace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The militarization of Israeli society is complemented by right-wing-backed free market reforms, austerity measures and other attacks on workers’ living standards.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These measures have made Israel less secure and vulnerable to a self-induced crisis economy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The recent massive public workers strike, led by the Histadrut Labour Federation, is a direct outcome of the government’s iron-wall intransigence, the financial burden of maintaining Israel as a garrison state, and efforts by the Likud-led government to privatize Israel’s public sector.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Continued violence buttresses the role of the most regressive elements in Palestinian society, at the expense of the emergence of a secular, progressive leadership.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports workers on both sides of the Green Line, but not their reactionary political leaderships.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Pro-peace and labor forces in both Palestine and Israel are the segments of the region’s societies with which DSA politically identifies and from which it draws strength.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Pro-peace and labor forces in both Palestine and Israel cannot succeed absent the aid of the international community.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
